details.description: Inconsistent dark mode implementation: some elements use Tailwind 'dark:' variants while the root does not set the 'dark' class based on state, so dark mode visuals are not applied consistently.
details.fix_explanation: Add the 'dark' class to the root container when darkMode is true so 'dark:' variants work. Keep explicit background/text classes for the root to ensure visual correctness.
details.before:
<div className={`min-h-screen p-4 ${darkMode ? "bg-gray-900 text-white" : "bg-white text-black"}`}>
...
<div className="border rounded p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 animate-pulse h-24" />
details.after:
<div role="main" className={`min-h-screen p-4 ${darkMode ? "dark bg-gray-900 text-white" : "bg-white text-black"}`}>
...
<div className="border rounded p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 animate-pulse h-24" aria-hidden="true" />

details.description: Loading skeletons have no accessible text for screen readers and empty self-closing divs; screen reader users will get no context.
details.fix_explanation: Add an sr-only status text inside the status container and mark decorative skeleton elements as aria-hidden.
details.before: ...
details.after:
Loading dashboard metrics
...

details.description: No empty-state handling: when metrics are empty and loading is false the grid renders nothing, which is confusing to users.
details.fix_explanation: Render an explicit 'No metrics available' placeholder card when metrics.length === 0.
details.after:
{metrics.length === 0 ? (
No metrics available.
) : (metrics.map(...))}

details.description: List item key uses only label which may not be unique and label/value text colors do not adapt to dark mode.
details.fix_explanation: Use a composite key (label + value) and add dark:text classes for label and value to ensure contrast in dark mode.
details.after:
{m.label}
{m.value.toLocaleString()}

details.description: Main content container lacks a main landmark role which is helpful for assistive technologies.
details.fix_explanation: Add role="main" to the root container.
details.after: <div role="main" className={`min-h-screen p-4 ${darkMode ? "dark bg-gray-900 text-white" : "bg-white text-black"}`}>
